name: Reflective TN, multiplexed 1/4 duty (Lumex LCD-S401M16KR drive on the VI-402 cell)

liquid_crystal.material: E7 (reference nematic mixture; the panel's own mixture is proprietary)
refs: Elastic constants and permittivities as quoted in arXiv:2003.09706 (citing Merck Licristal brochure 1994; Raynes et al. 2003; Yang et al. 1999; Raynes, Tough & Davies 1979)
Cauchy coefficients: J. Li, S.-T. Wu, S. Brugioni, R. Meucci, S. Faetti, J. Appl. Phys. 97, 073501 (2005), Table I, 25 C

panel.part: Varitronix VI-402-DP (positive gray TN, reflective, static drive, 6 o'clock)

geometry.pretilt_note: assumed typical rubbed-polyimide value; not in the datasheet
geometry.design: Gooch & Tarry (J. Phys. D 8, 1575, 1975) transmission maximum at 550 nm: first (2 d dn / lambda = sqrt 3) or second (sqrt 15); chosen by which reproduces the datasheet viewing cone (see derived)
geometry.glass_note: 1.10 mm per plate, confirmed by the Lumex LCD-S401M16KR drawing (two 1.10 mm plates, 2.80 mm max depth)
geometry.rear_polarizer_note: polarizer film thickness from the Orient Display polarizer table
geometry.index_note: typical soda-lime glass and polarizer film indices (assumed)

sources.colorimetry: CIE 1931 2-degree observer and CIE D65 from colour-science/colour datasets (BSD-3-Clause)

obliquity.method: extended Jones matrices (Lien 1990); polarizers as dichroic absorbers with transmitted field along k x absorption axis
obliquity.front_surface_note: Fresnel loss at the front surface relative to normal incidence; an untreated polarizer reflects about 5% (displaymodule.com), consistent with n = 1.5

viscosity_vs_temperature.ref: E7 rotational viscosity, experimental values supplied by Merck Korea, as tabulated in koreascience.kr JAKO201136151481811 (Table 2)

obliquity.temperature_scaling: elastic constants scale as S^2 and dielectric anisotropy as S (mean-field), with order parameter S proportional to birefringence; birefringence from the Li-Wu Cauchy table at each temperature

panel_multiplexed.drive: 1/4 duty, 1/3 bias, operating voltage 3.0 V AC
panel_multiplexed.not_given: response times and contrast; these come from the VI-402 cell
panel_multiplexed.ref: Lumex LCD-S401M16KR drawing, dated 06.13.11 (supplied by the user)

refs: ROHM BU9795AFV segment driver datasheet (1/3 bias, 1/4 duty; frame 53-80 Hz)
ON Semiconductor LC75814V 1/4-duty driver datasheet (1/2 or 1/3 bias)
drive.supply_rule: VLCD = 3.0 V from the Lumex LCD-S401M16KR drawing (the contrast optimum for the stand-in E7 cell would be reported as vlcd_optimum_V)
drive.note: same glass, crystal and polarizers as the VI-402 profile; only the drive differs. The liquid crystal responds to rms voltage because its response (tens of ms) is slower than the frame (12-19 ms).

oblique.viewing_cone_note: contrast >= 2 with light arriving from the viewing direction (reflective measurement); datasheet typ: bottom 70, top 35, left 70, right 70
